subject: The man exactly as in the first frame, the knee X-ray glowing on the lightbox behind him, both hands holding the strap out towards the camera.

camera.movement: Propped on the desk, not held, not tripod. Near-stillness with a slow unresolved drift, slightly off-level and never corrected.
camera.framing: Exactly as in the first and last frames.

motion: He holds the strap out to the camera and slowly turns it round, the front with the stryde wordmark turning away and the plain matte-black silicone pad coming round to face the camera, ending exactly on the last frame: the pad facing the lens, both peaks pointing up, the band loop in front. One smooth continuous turn, the peaks pointing up the whole time. Everything in frame keeps its exact form, proportion and count from first frame to last — nothing melts, merges, splits, grows or becomes something else. The rigid shell never bends, flexes or stretches from any angle. Mass and momentum in all movement: heavy starts and settles slow, nothing at uniform speed; hands arrive last; fabric and straps lag and settle; objects drag with friction, never glide.
lighting: Capture characteristics exactly as in the first frame — same tone-mapping, noise and colour temperature, no grading change.
negatives: no morphing, no warping, no melting, no shape shifting, no parts detaching, no proportions changing, no duplicate objects, no background bending, no texture swimming, no smearing, no shell bending, no shell curling into a ring, no peaks pointing down, no upside-down shell, no mirrored wordmark, no wordmark on the pad, no second strap, no fingers on the chrome slides, no text on screen, no music
